Smt. Vineeta Devi vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:146037
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31951 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Vineeta Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Satya Narayan Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Satya Narayan Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shatruhan Yadav,
learned Aga for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 55 of 2023, under Section 306 IPC, Police Station Eka, District Firozabad during pendency of the trial.
3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and her father under Section 306 IPC and according to the FIR due to the bad behavior of the applicant, her mother-in-law committed suicide.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and mother-in-law of the applicant committed suicide in the month of March, 2023 while applicant was residing in her paternal home since 2020 as some matrimonial dispute is pending between her and her in-laws.

He next submits that even before suicide of her mother-in-law, applicant earlier lodged FIR under Section 498A IPC against her and her family Smt. Vineeta Devi vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196360623/
1 members.

entities.text: Vineeta Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that entire allegation of abatement made against the applicant is totally false and baseless.
He next submits that applicant is a lady and in the present matter she is in jail since 03.03.2023.

5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is daughter-in-law of the deceased and some matrimonial dispute is pending between both sides and from the record it reflects that at the time of incident applicant was in her paternal home.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Although, there is allegation that due to bad behavior of the applicant, her mother-in-law committed suicide but from the record it reflects that some matrimonial dispute is pending between both sides and applicant was residing in her paternal home and even from the FIR it could not be reflected that due to the abatement of the applicant, her mother-in-law committed suicide.
8.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant, who is a lady, is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Smt. Vineeta Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
